security_privacy_cost_impact: Tightens only. created_by at INSERT is now bound by a restrictive closure on all nineteen tables that grant it, so no permissive policy, however loose, can admit a row naming another creator; every client-insertable *_by column must carry its column's pinned closure; and every permissive policy on the 25 client-writable app tables is pinned by name, command, roles and exact deparse, so a widening -- a new sibling or an in-place edit -- fails migrate-clean by name. psqlLex also refuses a spelled change of client encoding and is tested at odd runs of 3 and 5. No data, secret or cost impact.
